# Research exhibit implementation verification

This record covers the modular research presentation change in a working tree
that already contained unrelated changes. It does not certify those changes or
replace earlier verification records.

Implemented: SDK versioned research-view descriptors and complete-publication
validation; typed evidence/Haar history helpers; nine reusable compositions;
serving SDK reference topics, recursive source identity and wheel assets;
bounded HTTP evidence with exact large integral values; one explorer shared by
chat and workspace pages; registered panel primitives; scope-local study receipt
grouping and displayed sketch revision comparisons; knowledge/reference/sketch
cards; shared observational job polling; searchable publication guidance.

The gallery at `/demo/research` is generated by
`uv run --extra dev python scripts/fixtures/generate_research_gallery.py` from
the real SDK example through the production Python page projection. Its evidence
is explicitly synthetic. No historical artifact or external workspace study was
rewritten, and no new learned-model algorithm was introduced.

## Integration limitation and isolated checks

The single full `uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider` run collected
1,622 tests and was stopped at the repository three-minute budget around 41%.
It had no reported failures before termination. It is **not a full-suite pass**.
Delivery architecture, arrival reconciliation, canonical delivery, session input
snapshot and session delivery suites completed during that partial run.

The unfinished area was isolated with focused HTTP wire-schema, workspace
program and provider session-adapter suites. Wire-schema (8) and provider
adapter (43) passed. The workspace tests initially exposed an existing SDK
metadata test helper constructing `WorkspacePrograms(None)` without the now
required submission-store dependency. The helper now injects the existing
`MemorySubmissions` test port; the complete 116-test workspace suite then passed.
No unchanged full-suite rerun was performed.

The job-card test also now permits the same truthful session count in both the
summary and expanded evidence, and supplies backend context in its external API
mock. No production admission or session delivery rule was relaxed.
